text: Entry Requirements 1) Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens, under the age of 35, with valid foreign passports, in good health physically and mentally; 2) Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC shall be met; 3) Applicants shall hold Senior High School Diploma; Provisional graduation certificate is acceptable upon application, while the official Senior High School Diploma shall be submitted prior to registration at ZCMU; 4) For English taught programs, applicants are required to submit scores of the Test of English as a Foreign Language Internet Based Test (TOEFL iBT), International English Language Testing System (IELTS), or the Duolingo English Test (DET) as evidence of English Proficiency. The applicant shall at least have the score of 6 for IELTS, 86 for TOEFL iBT or 110 for the Duolingo English Test (DET). Native-English speakers can apply for waiver of English Proficiency. Applicants whose last study was instructed in English can submit the English test result of senior secondary school leaving certificate and an English-medium instruction certificate as evidence of English proficiency.
